title: Defined term, without a rule — a definition slip linked to the word and one with no linked definition, side by side
titleEs: Término definido — Comparación de dos supuestos
description: Two identical stages (two parties and their pigeonhole racks): in both, Party A's definitions sheet (●), a placeholder definition slip in its dock, travels to Party B, the term station is reached and Party B's contract (◆, at equal weight, its row with the word under a cover) then travels to Party A and is unfolded — at the same moments in both. The one changed fact is the supplied configuration: in A (defined term, as supplied) Party B's hand moves the slip into the contract's dock and, once the contract is unfolded, a thread links the word to it; in B (term with no linked definition, as supplied) the slip stays in the sheet's dock and no thread is drawn. The destination dock takes the same solid outline in each scene. A guide outlines the differing row of the comparison table; the key reads "As supplied · no conclusion drawn". No winner, no interpretation rule and no conclusion about what the word means.
